## 📌 Project Overview

A **corporate-grade, end-to-end data analytics project** simulating the full workflow of a professional data analyst — raw CSV → Python cleaning → PostgreSQL analysis → Power BI dashboard → stakeholder report.

**Dataset covers 18 features across:**

| 👤 Demographics | 🛒 Purchase Details | 📦 Behavior |
|----------------|---------------------|-------------|
| Age, Gender | Item, Category, Amount | Discount Usage |
| Location | Season, Size, Color | Shipping Type |
| Subscription Status | Payment Method | Review Rating, Frequency |

## 🐍 Step 1 — Data Preparation & EDA (Python)

**3,900 rows × 18 columns · 37 missing values in `review_rating`**

| 🔧 Step | ✅ Action |
|---------|-----------|
| Missing Data | Imputed 37 nulls using **median per product category** |
| Standardization | Renamed all columns to `snake_case` |
| Redundancy | `promo_code_used` duplicated `discount_applied` → **dropped** |
| Feature Engineering | `age_group` (age bins) + `purchase_frequency_days` |
| DB Load | Cleaned DataFrame → **PostgreSQL** via SQLAlchemy |

| | Age | Purchase Amount | Review Rating |
|-|-----|----------------|---------------|
| Mean | 44.07 | $59.76 | 3.75 |
| Std | 15.21 | $23.69 | 0.72 |
| Min | 18 | $20 | 2.5 |
| Max | 70 | $100 | 5.0 |

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tinayerne04/retail-customer-behavior-analysis.git
cd retail-customer-behavior-analysis
pip install pandas sqlalchemy psycopg2 jupyter matplotlib seaborn
jupyter notebook Customer_Shopping_Behavior_Analysis.ipynb
```

## 💡 Business Recommendations

| # | Finding | Action |
|---|---------|--------|
| 1 | Only 27% subscribed | Launch exclusive perks to convert the 73% |
| 2 | 80% already Loyal | Shift budget: acquisition → upsell & basket growth |
| 3 | Hat, Sneakers, Coat ~50% discount rate | Audit pricing — protect margins |
| 4 | Gloves, Sandals, Boots rated highest | Feature in campaigns — social proof converts |
| 5 | Young Adults = $62,143 top revenue | Priority segment for targeting |
| 6 | 2,518 repeat buyers not subscribed | Trigger subscription nudge after 3rd purchase |
